params.prompt: Photorealistic architectural photograph, same contemporary house throughout: raw light-grey concrete walls and floors, brushed brass doors and volumes, dark olive upholstered built-in seating, warm natural daylight, eye-level camera at 1.5 m, 24 mm lens, perfectly straight vertical lines, calm editorial photography, no people, no text, 16:9. The camera has moved forward about 5 meters from this threshold into the hall and now stands at the entrance of the living room: the brass volume on the right, the long low olive sofa and stone coffee table ahead, concrete floor with sun patches, same materials as reference.
